accountIntelligenceView.markdownDescription:
Setup: **Feature Settings → Sales → Account Intelligence** (`/lightning/setup/AccountInspectionSettings/home`)

Turns the Account Intelligence view on or off.

![Account Intelligence View](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/accountIntelligenceView/overview.webp)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/accountIntelligenceView/)

activitySettings.markdownDescription:
Setup: **Feature Settings → Sales → Activity Settings** (`/lightning/setup/HomeActivitiesSetupPage/home`)

Although the Metadata API has an `ActivitiesSettings.allowUsersToRelateMultipleContactsToTasksAndEvents` field, it is read-only since API v36.0: the setting cannot be enabled through an API.

![Activity Settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/activitySettings/overview.webp)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/activitySettings/)

authProviders.markdownDescription:
Setup: **Identity → Auth. Providers** (`/lightning/setup/AuthProviders/home`)

Updates the Consumer Key and the Consumer Secret of existing Auth Providers, keyed by their API name. Reference the secret with an environment variable (`"${MY_SECRET}"`) rather than writing it in the config file: it is masked in the output of `apply`.

![Auth. Provider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/authProviders/overview.webp)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/authProviders/)

callSummaries.markdownDescription:
Setup: **Salesforce Go → Call Summaries** (`/lightning/setup/page/feature/sales-cloud-call-summaries/home`)

Turns on Call Summaries, the summaries of voice and video calls written by Einstein generative AI, and waits until Salesforce has created the object that stores them. Deploying `ConversationalIntelligenceSettings` with `enableCallSummarization` often fails with `OrgPreferences.GenECI`, and the setting can read `true` before that object exists. Turning it off uses the Metadata API.

![Call Summaries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/callSummaries/overview.webp)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/callSummaries/)

companyInformation.markdownDescription:
Setup: **Company Settings → Company Information** (`/lightning/setup/CompanyProfileInfo/home`)

Sets the Currency Locale of the org, which no Metadata API type represents.

![Company Information](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/companyInformation/overview.webp)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/companyInformation/)

customerPortal.markdownDescription:
Salesforce Classic Setup: **Customize → Customer Portal → Customer Portal Settings** (`/_ui/core/portal/CustomerSuccessPortalSetup/e`)

Enables the Customer Portal, configures its portals (self-registration, profiles) and the custom objects available in it.

![Customer Portal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/customerPortal/overview.webp)

![Customer Portal Setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/customer-portal-setup.png)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/customerPortal/)

densitySettings.markdownDescription:
Setup: **User Interface → Density Settings** (`/lightning/setup/DensitySetup/home`)

Chooses the default display density of the org: "Comfy" or "Compact".

![Density Settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/density-settings.png)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/densitySettings/)

einsteinConversationInsights.markdownDescription:
Setup: **Einstein Conversation Insights** (`/lightning/setup/CallCoachingSettings/home`)

Turns on Einstein Conversation Insights through the Metadata API (`ConversationalIntelligenceSettings.enableCallCoaching`), then waits until Salesforce has created the objects that store the conversations: a deployment returns as soon as the setting is saved, while turning the feature on can take more than 30 minutes. It cannot be turned off again.

![Einstein Conversation Insights](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/einsteinConversationInsights/overview.webp)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/einsteinConversationInsights/)

emailDeliverability.markdownDescription:
Setup: **Email → Deliverability** (`/lightning/setup/OrgEmailSettings/home`)

Chooses the access level: "No access", "System email only" or "All email".

![Email Deliverability](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/emailDeliverability/overview.webp)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/emailDeliverability/)

highVelocitySalesSettings.markdownDescription:
Setup: **Feature Settings → Sales → Sales Engagement → Sales Engagement Settings** (`/lightning/setup/SalesEngagement/home`)

Due to a bug, High Velocity Sales (Sales Engagement) needs to be set up and enabled initially using the user interface. Once set up, it can be configured with the [HighVelocitySalesSettings](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_highvelocitysalessettings.htm) metadata.

![Set Up and Enable Sales Engagement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/highVelocitySalesSettings/overview.webp)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/highVelocitySalesSettings/)

historyTracking.title: History Tracking
historyTracking.description:
Enables or disables history tracking on objects and on their fields (**Object Manager → Fields & Relationships → Set History Tracking**).

It closes a gap of the Metadata API, which cannot enable field history tracking on custom Person Account fields.

![Set History Tracking](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/historyTracking/overview.webp)
x-prerequisites: Person Accounts enabled, to track Person Account fields
historyTracking.markdownDescription:

It closes a gap of the Metadata API, which cannot enable field history tracking on custom Person Account fields.

![Set History Tracking](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/historyTracking/overview.webp)

homePageLayouts.markdownDescription:
Salesforce Classic Setup: **Customize → Home → Home Page Layouts** (`/setup/ui/assignhomelayoutedit.jsp`)

Assigns Home Page Layouts to profiles.

![Home Page Layout Assignment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/homePageLayouts/overview.webp)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/homePageLayouts/)

lightningExperienceSettings.markdownDescription:
Setup: **User Interface → Themes and Branding** (`/lightning/setup/ThemingAndBranding/home`)

Activates a Lightning Experience theme. Although the Metadata API has an `activeThemeName` field in `LightningExperienceSettings`, it cannot activate the standard themes like `Lightning`, `LightningLite` or `SalesforceCosmos`.

![Themes and Branding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/lightning-experience-settings.png)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/lightningExperienceSettings/)

listViewCustomButtons.title: List View Custom Buttons
listViewCustomButtons.description:
Object Manager: **(object) → Search Layouts for Salesforce Classic → List View**

Manages the custom buttons selected in the list view button layout of any object. Buttons are identified by the API name of their WebLink, with an optional namespace prefix (`AssignTask` or `th_dev__AssignTask`).

![List View Custom Buttons](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/listViewCustomButtons/overview.webp)
listViewCustomButtons.markdownDescription:
Object Manager: **(object) → Search Layouts for Salesforce Classic → List View**

linkedInSalesNavigatorSettings.markdownDescription:
Setup: **Feature Settings → Sales → LinkedIn Sales Navigator** (`/lightning/setup/LinkedInSalesNavigatorPage/home`)

Enables or disables the Sales Navigator integration.

![LinkedIn Sales Navigator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/linkedInSalesNavigatorSettings/overview.webp)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/linkedInSalesNavigatorSettings/)

omniChannelSettings.markdownDescription:
Setup: **Feature Settings → Service → Omni-Channel → Omni-Channel Settings** (`/lightning/setup/OmniChannelSettings/home`)

Enables the status-based capacity model.

![Omni-Channel Settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/omniChannelSettings/overview.webp)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/omniChannelSettings/)

opportunitySplits.markdownDescription:
Setup: **Feature Settings → Sales → Opportunities → Opportunity Splits Settings** (`/lightning/setup/OpportunitySplitSetup/home`)

Enables and sets up Opportunity Splits. Opportunity Teams must be enabled first, for example by deploying the `Opportunity` settings with `<enableOpportunityTeam>true</enableOpportunityTeam>`.

![Opportunity Splits Settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/opportunitySplits/overview.webp)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/opportunitySplits/)

permissionSets.title: Permission Sets
permissionSets.description:
Gives Permission Sets access to service presence statuses (Omni-Channel), by the API names of the statuses.

![Service Presence Statuses Access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/permissionSets/overview.webp)
permissionSets.markdownDescription:
Gives Permission Sets access to service presence statuses (Omni-Channel), by the API names of the statuses.

![Service Presence Statuses Access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/permissionSets/overview.webp)

recordTypes.markdownDescription:
Deletes inactive record types, optionally replacing them by another record type where they are used.

![Record Types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/recordTypes/overview.webp)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/recordTypes/)

relateContactToMultipleAccounts.markdownDescription:
Setup: **Feature Settings → Sales → Account Settings** (`/lightning/setup/AccountSettings/home`)

Enabling it through the Metadata API (`AccountSettings.enableRelateContactToMultipleAccounts`) does not always make the `AccountContactRelation` object available. Enabling it in Setup always does.

![Account Settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/relateContactToMultipleAccounts/overview.webp)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/relateContactToMultipleAccounts/)

reportsAndDashboards.markdownDescription:
Setup: **Feature Settings → Analytics → Reports & Dashboards → Folder Sharing**

Enables Enhanced Folder Sharing. Orgs created after the Summer ’13 release already have it.

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/reportsAndDashboards/)

salesforceCpqConfig.markdownDescription:
Setup: **Installed Packages → Salesforce CPQ → Configure**

Sets the settings of the Salesforce CPQ package.

![Salesforce CPQ settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/salesforce-cpq-config.png)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/salesforceCpqConfig/)

security.markdownDescription:
**Certificate and Key Management**: Setup **Security → Certificate and Key Management** (`/lightning/setup/CertificatesAndKeysManagement/home`). Imports certificates from a Java Keystore (JKS) and creates self-signed certificates.

![Import Certificate from Keystore](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/security/overview.webp)

**Authentication Configuration**: Setup **Company Settings → My Domain** (`/lightning/setup/OrgDomain/home`). Toggles the authentication services of the Authentication Configuration section.

![Authentication Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/security-authentication-configuration.png)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/security/)

serviceChannels.title: Service Channels
serviceChannels.description:
Configures the capacity model of Service Channels (Omni-Channel): status-based capacity, the status field and its in-progress values.

![Service Channel capacity](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/serviceChannels/overview.webp)
x-prerequisites: Omni-Channel enabled, with the status-based capacity model (omniChannelSettings)
serviceChannels.markdownDescription:
Configures the capacity model of Service Channels (Omni-Channel): status-based capacity, the status field and its in-progress values.

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/serviceChannels/)

slack.markdownDescription:
Setup: **Slack → Slack Apps Setup** (`/lightning/setup/SlackSetupAssistant/home`)

Agrees to the terms and conditions and enables the Sales Cloud for Slack app.

![Slack Apps Setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/slack.png)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/slack/)

userAccessPolicies.markdownDescription:
Setup: **Users → User Access Policies** (`/lightning/setup/UserAccessPolicies/home`)

Activates or deactivates User Access Policies, chooses when they run (on create, update, or both), and runs Apply To All.

![User Access Policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/userAccessPolicies/overview.webp)

[Documentation](https://amtrack.github.io/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/settings/userAccessPolicies/)

enabled.title: Enable Call Summaries
enabled.description:
Turning on Call Summaries using ConversationalIntelligenceSettings Metadata (enableCallSummarization) often fails with OrgPreferences.GenECI, so it is turned on in Setup > Salesforce Go > Call Summaries instead.
It is turned off using Metadata https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_conversationalintelligencesettings.htm

callSummaries.title: Call Summaries
callSummaries.description:
Setup: **Salesforce Go → Call Summaries** (`/lightning/setup/page/feature/sales-cloud-call-summaries/home`)

Turns on Call Summaries, the summaries of voice and video calls written by Einstein generative AI, and waits until Salesforce has created the object that stores them. Deploying `ConversationalIntelligenceSettings` with `enableCallSummarization` often fails with `OrgPreferences.GenECI`, and the setting can read `true` before that object exists. Turning it off uses the Metadata API.

![Call Summaries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/callSummaries/overview.webp)

Sets the Currency Locale of the org, which no Metadata API type represents.

![Company Information](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/companyInformation/overview.webp)

enabled.title: Enable Customer Portal
enabled.description: Although the Metadata API has a OrgSettings.enableCustomerSuccessPortal field, enabling this via the browser can be handy because it automatically creates a Portal named 'Customer Portal', where the admin and emailSenderAddress are set to the current user. Warning: cannot be disabled once enabled

Salesforce Classic Setup: **Customize → Customer Portal → Customer Portal Settings** (`/_ui/core/portal/CustomerSuccessPortalSetup/e`)

Enables the Customer Portal, configures its portals (self-registration, profiles) and the custom objects available in it.

![Customer Portal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/customerPortal/overview.webp)

density.title: Density
density.description: Choose the default display setting for your org

densitySettings.title: Density Settings
densitySettings.description:
Setup: **User Interface → Density Settings** (`/lightning/setup/DensitySetup/home`)

Chooses the default display density of the org: "Comfy" or "Compact".

![Density Settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/density-settings.png)

enabled.title: Enable Einstein Conversation Insights
enabled.description:
Turning on Einstein Conversation Insights in the scratch org definition can take more than 30 minutes to complete, and a Metadata deploy does not wait for it to complete.
It is turned on using ConversationalIntelligenceSettings Metadata (enableCallCoaching) after the org is created, waiting until it is completely turned on https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_conversationalintelligencesettings.htm
Warning: it cannot be turned off using Browserforce.

einsteinConversationInsights.title: Einstein Conversation Insights
einsteinConversationInsights.description:
Setup: **Einstein Conversation Insights** (`/lightning/setup/CallCoachingSettings/home`)

Turns on Einstein Conversation Insights through the Metadata API (`ConversationalIntelligenceSettings.enableCallCoaching`), then waits until Salesforce has created the objects that store the conversations: a deployment returns as soon as the setting is saved, while turning the feature on can take more than 30 minutes. It cannot be turned off again.

![Einstein Conversation Insights](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/einsteinConversationInsights/overview.webp)
x-prerequisites: Einstein Conversation Insights license (scratch org feature CallCoaching)

Once set up, it can be configured with the [HighVelocitySalesSettings](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_highvelocitysalessettings.htm) metadata.

![Set Up and Enable Sales Engagement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/highVelocitySalesSettings/overview.webp)
x-prerequisites: High Velocity Sales license (scratch org feature HighVelocitySales)

enabled.description: This allows you to enable the 'Relate contact to multiple Accounts' in the Account settings. Doing this through the metadata API will not always make the AccountContactRelation object available. Enabling the feature using the setup does always work, therefore this plugin.

relateContactToMultipleAccounts.title: RelateContactToMultipleAccounts Settings
relateContactToMultipleAccounts.description:
Setup: **Feature Settings → Sales → Account Settings** (`/lightning/setup/AccountSettings/home`)

Enabling it through the Metadata API (`AccountSettings.enableRelateContactToMultipleAccounts`) does not always make the `AccountContactRelation` object available. Enabling it in Setup always does.

![Account Settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/relateContactToMultipleAccounts/overview.webp)

security.title: Security Controls
security.description:
**Certificate and Key Management**: Setup **Security → Certificate and Key Management** (`/lightning/setup/CertificatesAndKeysManagement/home`). Imports certificates from a Java Keystore (JKS) and creates self-signed certificates.

![Import Certificate from Keystore](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/security/overview.webp)

**Authentication Configuration**: Setup **Company Settings → My Domain** (`/lightning/setup/OrgDomain/home`). Toggles the authentication services of the Authentication Configuration section.

![Authentication Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/security-authentication-configuration.png)

name.description: Optional new name of the certificate. WARNING: Only use this to change the case of the certificate name as the imported name is lowercase by default.

filePath.description: Relative path from current working directory

label.description: The visible name of the authentication service

authProviderApiName.description: The DeveloperName of the AuthProvider (alternative to label for matching)

enabled.description: True to enable, false to disable

services.description: List of Authentication Services to configure under My Domain, each with desired enabled state

accessPolicies.title: Access Policies
accessPolicies.description: List of user access policies to activate, deactivate or apply to all users

userAccessPolicies.title: User Access Policies
userAccessPolicies.description:
Setup: **Users → User Access Policies** (`/lightning/setup/UserAccessPolicies/home`)

Activates or deactivates User Access Policies, chooses when they run (on create, update, or both), and runs Apply To All.

![User Access Policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amtrack/sfdx-browserforce-plugin/main/docs/assets/settings/userAccessPolicies/overview.webp)
x-prerequisites: User Access Policies enabled (User Management Settings)

apiName.description: The API name of the user access policy (e.g., 'Grant_Permissions')

active.description: Whether the policy should be active (true) or inactive (false). Leave it out to keep the current status of the policy.

on.description: Optional: specify when to apply the policy - 'Create', 'Update', or 'CreateAndUpdate'. Only used when active is true.

applyToAll.title: Apply To All
applyToAll.description: Run Apply To All once the policy is set: assigns its access to every user matching its criteria. Runs Apply To All at each apply: Salesforce keeps no state that tells it already ran. A run cannot be undone.
